effects.name: source-selection-policy-write
effects.system: Portal Operational Store SQLite database, through operational-store@5
effects.detail: Appends one pending Source Selection Policy that supersedes exactly the live policies of its measure and record type that share a date with it; a request identical to a live policy in the unit's read writes nothing, and a refusal, or a store failure before the write commits, commits nothing. A failure raised after the write commits propagates unchanged and leaves the policy committed, and a retry is then a repeat. It queues no Processing Job and activates nothing.
